purpose: Teach: 伴わ/望め/不運/奨め/ドンドン/浮かび上がっ/不機嫌/塗る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様を伴わずにいらしてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a regular customer came in today without their child.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost thinking aloud. Gentle curiosity underneath. Slight warmth noticing the small change. Pace unhurried, like she's turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店の新メニューに望めるものがあるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, they seemed interested in the new menu items.
lines.style: Responsive and warm. A small nod in the voice. Not defensive—just sharing what she noticed. Steady, present tone. Natural rhythm of two people who know each other.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、不運な日常を癒しに来て下さるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I think they come in to escape their rough days.
lines.style: Tender and quiet. Recognition without judgment. Slight pause before speaking, as if handling something fragile. Warm undertone—this matters to her. Soft exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にお気に入りの本を奨めてみたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I recommended my favorite book to them the other day.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. A small offering made without fanfare. Light tone—practical kindness. Not seeking credit, just sharing something she thought might help.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、ドンドンお客様が増えてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop's been getting busier. More people coming in.
lines.style: Pleased and grounded. Genuine satisfaction in the voice. Not loud—just quiet pride in what they've built together. Steady rhythm, warm at the center.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の表情が浮かび上がってくる照明にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe we adjust the lighting so it catches people's faces better when they walk in.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, almost conversational. Not directive—collaborative. Slight lift of imagination in the tone. Picturing something. Gentle and exploratory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お疲れで不機嫌そうな時もあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some customers look so tired when they come through the door.
lines.style: Observant and tender. Recognition tinged with quiet concern. Not complaining—noticing. Slow, careful pace. A person who sees the weight people carry.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、店内の壁を綺麗に塗る計画よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should paint the walls inside soon. Make it feel fresher.
lines.style: Practical warmth with gentle purpose. Forward-looking but unhurried. A suggestion made with care, not urgency. Small smile in the tone. We-focused.
